function.name: read_file_aloud
function.description: Reads the content of a local text file (.txt, .md, .csv, .json, etc) and outputs it so the system can read it out loud to the user.

file_path.description: The absolute or relative path to the file to read.

start_line.description: Optional line number to start reading from. Useful if the user asks you to resume reading or skip ahead.
